绳波。考虑绳上张力 $T$ 恒定。

由竖直方向受力分析：

$$T(x+\mathrm{d}x)\cdot\cos\theta(x+\mathrm{d}x)=T(x)\cdot\cos\theta(x)$$

竖直方向：

$$T\cdot\sin\theta(x+\mathrm{d}x)-T\sin\theta(x)=\eta\cdot\mathrm{d}x\cdot\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}$$

小角度近似：

$$\sin\theta\approx\tan\theta\approx\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$$

$$T\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big|_{x+\mathrm{d}x}-T\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big|_{x}=\rho\cdot\mathrm{d}x\cdot\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}$$

$$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}=\frac{T}{\eta}\cdot\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$$

$$u(x,t)=f(x-vt)+g(x+vt)$$

$$v=\sqrt{\frac{T}{\eta}}$$

驻波解：

$$v=\sqrt{\frac{T}{\rho}}=\frac{\omega}{k}$$

$$u(x,t)=A\cos(\omega t-kx+\varphi_1)+B\cos(\omega t+kx+\varphi_2)$$

绳两端固定，张力 $T$，求本征频率。

$$\lambda=\frac{L}{n}\cdot 2$$

$$n=1,2,\cdots$$

$$f_n(x,t)=A\cdot e^{i(\omega t+kx+\varphi_1)}+B\cdot e^{i(\omega t-kx+\varphi_2)}$$

由 $f(0,t)=0$，得

$$\left\{\begin{aligned}&A\cdot e^{i\omega t+i\varphi_1}=-B e^{i\omega t+i\varphi_2}\\&A\cdot e^{i\omega t+i\varphi_1+ikL}=-B\cdot e^{i\omega t+i\varphi_2-ikL}\end{aligned}\right.$$

$$\Rightarrow e^{ikL}=e^{-ikL}$$

$$\sin kL=0$$

$$kL=\pi\cdot n$$

$$n=1,2,3,\cdots$$

$$k=\frac{\pi}{L}\cdot n$$

$$\lambda=\frac{2\pi}{k}=\frac{2\pi}{\pi}\cdot\frac{L}{n}=2\cdot\frac{L}{n}$$
questions.answer: **两端固定绳的本征波长 $\lambda_n=\dfrac{2L}{n}$，本征频率 $f_n=\dfrac{n}{2L}\sqrt{\dfrac{T}{\eta}}$（$n=1,2,3,\cdots$）。**

推导绝热大气中的声速。

记之气层（微元）满足

$$p \cdot V^{\gamma} = \text{const}$$

$$\frac{dp}{p} + \gamma \cdot \frac{dV}{V} = 0$$

![](data/images/2024-bfe54f07/2024-质心-寒假-第十套-32.jpg)

对 $x \to x+\delta x$ 内：

$$\frac{dV}{V} = \frac{\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \delta x}{\delta x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$$

$$U(x+\delta x) - U(x) = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \delta x$$

$$\frac{dp}{p} = -\gamma \cdot \frac{dV}{V} = -\gamma \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$$

$$dp = -p_0 \cdot \gamma \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$$

考虑 $x \to x+\delta x$ 的气层

$$S \cdot \delta x \cdot \rho_0 \cdot \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = \left( \left( p_0 + dp_{(x)} \right) - \left( p_0 + dp_{(x+\delta x)} \right) \right) S$$

$$\delta x \cdot \rho_0 \cdot \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = \gamma p_0 \cdot \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} \cdot \delta x$$

$$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\gamma p_0}{\rho_0} \cdot \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$$

$$v = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma p_0}{\rho_0}} = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma \cdot n R T_0}{M}} = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma R T_0}{M}}$$

$$p_0 \cdot V = n R T_0$$

$$p_0 = \frac{n R T_0}{V} = \frac{n \cdot N_A \cdot k \cdot T_0}{V}$$

$$\frac{p_0}{\rho_0} = \gamma \cdot \frac{n \cdot N_A \cdot k \cdot T_0}{V \cdot \rho_0} = \gamma \cdot \frac{n \cdot N_A \cdot k T_0}{n \cdot M}$$

$$p \cdot V^{\gamma} = \text{const}$$

$$dp \cdot V^{\gamma} + p \cdot \gamma \cdot V^{\gamma-1} \cdot dV = 0$$

$$dp \cdot V + p \cdot \gamma \cdot dV = 0$$
